remaining_risks: Copilot also suggested tightening tests/governance/test_validate_change_contract.py's accept-case test with an additional 'assert r.proof_only is True'. Investigated: this test file has two unrelated pre-existing tests (test_proof_only_path_mismatch_detected_when_delta_readable, test_quarantine_forbids_signature) that dynamically read live git HEAD~1 and are fragile to whatever commit precedes HEAD -- adding any new commit on top (proof-only or not) can flip their outcome independent of code correctness. tests/governance/ is not part of the required CI 'Unit Tests' job (scoped to tests/unit, tests/test_voice_core.py, tests/test_brand_voice.py, services/working-memory-assistant tests, tests/dcp/) so this is not a merge blocker. Not applying the suggestion here to avoid entangling an unrelated, pre-existing test-fragility issue with this PR's scope; left for separate remediation.
